facts.business: Modulex Construction Technologies Limited is engaged in the business of modular construction and prefabricated building systems, offering integrated solutions spanning design, engineering, manufacturing and project execution.

capacity_or_capex.item: Advanced steel modular manufacturing facility at Indapur, Pune
capacity_or_capex.timeline: FY 2025-26: Completed construction of one manufacturing shed, installed key machinery and commenced trial production; final phase of operational stabilisation

guidance_or_targets.statement: Planned annual capacity of approximately 2,00,000 sq. meters configured across four production lines

auditor.name: M/s. Dhadda & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern; Emphasis of Matters: (a) Net loss of INR 44.33 lakhs and accumulated negative retained earnings of INR 853.96 lakhs as at March 31, 2026; (b) Unpaid TDS liabilities of INR 30.22 lakhs including interest of INR 8.05 lakhs, and unpaid GST under RCM of INR 28.77 lakhs with interest provision of INR 5.42 lakhs; (c) Investment in subsidiary MMBPL evaluated via independent valuation, no impairment recognised.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to net losses and current liabilities exceeding current assets
Delays in implementation of Pune project through subsidiary MMBPL
Unpaid statutory liabilities (TDS and GST) with interest provisions
Dependence on promoter and investor financial support for project completion and obligations
facts.related_party_note: Corporate Guarantee of Rs. 200 lakhs given to subsidiary Modulex Modular Buildings Pvt. Ltd. against loan; commitment to provide financial support to subsidiary as and when required.
